proposition: Jamāl al-Dīn Muḥammad wrote to Isfahan officials that he had been sent from Herat to Shiraz to study and feared never finishing if he returned to Herat; Ḥabīb Allāh left for Herat after a money quarrel with his brother, and Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī intervened and housed him.

mediation.who: Munshaʾāt-i Yazdī (letters of Jamāl al-Dīn and of Sharaf al-Dīn)
